name: the-placement-result-cannot-be-unpacked-into-two
breaks: the two-part unpacking shim comes back, so a caller can write `body, moved = repair_marker_placement(...)`, get no error, and never see the refusals: the half that has no other record once the post is published. A foot-gun inside the code that exists to stop a refused photo move going unnoticed, and the same shape as a default that quietly drops what the caller needed (#1172, L168)
